question: Should this PR land as the direct WebChat Stop recovery after rebase, accepting startedAt as the same-session run-generation guard and leaving compaction/restartRecoveryRuns recovery separate?
rationale: The code path is a session-state boundary and the branch now conflicts with current main, so automation should not decide the lifecycle invariant or broaden the scope without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Direct Fix After Rebase
options.body: Refit the branch to current main, keep the direct Stop recovery scope, and land after confirming the startedAt run-generation invariant.

options.title: Broaden To Compaction Recovery
options.body: Require added proof and regression coverage for the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns remap report before landing this branch.

options.title: Pause For Unified Lifecycle Design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one stronger owner for Stop, restart recovery, and compaction races before any partial fix lands.

recommendation.title: Accept Direct Fix After Rebase
recommendation.body: Refit the branch to current main, keep the direct Stop recovery scope, and land after confirming the startedAt run-generation invariant.
